technical_debts.issue: causal grade labels conflict across domains
attribution and before-after changes can be renamed incremental
current DiD is not valid for staggered heterogeneous treatment
current synthetic control lacks placebo and uncertainty
unconditional binary Wald intervals have weak boundary coverage
few-cluster inference and degrees of freedom are ungoverned
ratio and repeated-event metrics can mismatch randomization unit
no unified sequential and hypothesis-family ledger
uplift evaluation lacks cross-fit calibration and policy value
F01 and F02 have no foundation capability registry

limitations: static inventory does not prove runtime behavior
consumer acceptance remains required in WP-11
no existing estimator is grandfathered into CE4 or CE5
